name: align-block-moved
description: e1 rewrites the second import line. Afterwards something uncaptured cuts the two import lines and pastes them below the constants (`A B C D E` becomes `C D E A B`). Rule 5 procedure: all five texts are unique on both sides; the longest chain of anchors in the same relative order is C D E (three lines, unique: the other candidate, A B, has only two), so C D E keep their origin (base). The moved block does not keep its relative order against them, so it is not matched: both moved lines are Unknown(noCapture), including the one e1 wrote.
